label_semantics: Six image-plane points: top back left/right, top front right/left, front bottom left/right. Missing cropped corners have visibility zero. No hidden edge or depth target.
review_evidence: All 27 numbered 4x4 contact sheets inspected, followed by full-resolution previews for every non-crop quality flag.
source_exclusions: Preserve 82 excluded source images and the 48-image near-duplicate embargo from collection_v1.
acceptance_rule: Accept the visible-edge proposal for each source-approved instance after visual review. Excluded and approved-empty source frames keep their prior status.
